                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))

                # Only treat connected frame components at least 4 pixels wide/high.

                if color == 6 and (r1-r0+1)==4: fill=2
                elif color == 9 and (r1-r0+1)==7: fill=7
                else: continue
                for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                    for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                        if grid[y][x] not in (color,): out[y][x]=fill
    # Fill centers of the small 3x3 ring motifs with 7.
    for r in range(R-2):
        for c in range(C-2):

    seen = set()

        for c in range(w):

            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:

            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells); r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells); c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)

def transform(grid):
    """Fill hollow rectangular outlines: 4x4 outlines get 2; others get 7."""
    from collections import Counter, deque
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy, xx) not in seen
                            and grid[yy][xx] == color):
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        q.append((yy, xx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells); r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells); c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            if not all(grid[r0][x] == color and grid[r1][x] == color for x in range(c0, c1+1)):
                continue
            if not all(grid[y][c0] == color and grid[y][c1] == color for y in range(r0, r1+1)):
                continue
            # Only fill an empty rectangular interior, leaving the outline intact.
            if any(grid[y][x] != background for y in range(r0+1, r1) for x in range(c0+1, c1)):
                continue
            fill = 2 if (r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1) == (4, 4) else 7
            for y in range(r0+1, r1):
                for x in range(c0+1, c1):
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out
